canonical_name: No Security and Privacy Function Verification
description: Security and privacy functions are not verified to operate correctly and are not monitored for anomalous behavior.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing security function testing procedures, absence of automated verification mechanisms, lack of anomaly detection for security controls, and no documented verification schedules.
